item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 27/Feb/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will bring generally fine weather to the coast of Guangdong in the next few days. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. With the monsoon moderating slightly on Wednesday, temperatures will rise slightly over the region and there will be some haze.

Date/Month: 28/02 (Tuesday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore at first.
Weather: Mainly fine. Cool in the morning. Dry during the day.
Temp range: 15 - 21 C
R.H. range: 55 - 80 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 01/03 (Wednesday)
